scenarios.title: A boast ability can be activated only if its creature attacked this turn
decisions: A declares Fearless Liberator and Grizzly Bears as attackers against B.
In the declare blockers step A activates Fearless Liberator's boast ability ({2}{R}), tapping three Mountains.
Both players pass; the ability resolves.

variants.label: liberator_attacked
variants.expected: The boast activation is legal. The ability resolves and A gets a 2/1 red Dwarf Berserker creature token. All three Mountains are tapped.

variants.label: liberator_stayed_home
variants.delta: A declares only Grizzly Bears as an attacker; Fearless Liberator does not attack.
variants.expected: The boast activation is not legal (Fearless Liberator did not attack this turn). No token is created and the Mountains stay untapped.

scenarios.title: A boast ability can be activated only once each turn
decisions: A declares Fearless Liberator as an attacker against B.
In the declare blockers step A activates Fearless Liberator's boast ability ({2}{R}), tapping three Mountains.
Both players pass; the ability resolves.

variants.label: first_activation
variants.expected: The boast activation is legal and resolves: A gets one 2/1 red Dwarf Berserker creature token. Three Mountains are untapped.

variants.label: second_activation
variants.delta: After the first boast ability resolves, A tries to activate it a second time this turn, tapping the other three Mountains.
variants.expected: The second activation is not legal (boast was already activated this turn). A still has exactly one Dwarf Berserker token and three untapped Mountains.
